dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a deep inward curvature between the apex and the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Smoothly rounded apex classification with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin rising at approximately a 65-degree angle from the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin displays a vertical elongation with a height-to-base-width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct notches and irregular indentations along the posterior trailing edge, particularly concentrated on the lower half.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of small, white, punctate speckles or spots across the dark lateral surface of the fin and the adjacent dorsal region.
